br_description: Normalise donor and counterparty names before comparing, so punctuation, legal form suffixes and casing do not prevent a match
Extract structured references such as invoice numbers, donation ids and SEPA end to end ids from the free text remittance information
When the received amount is short, test whether the difference equals a known bank charge before treating it as a mismatch
Classify an unmatched debit as a bank charge, interest or service charge using the bank transaction code before proposing a posting
Treat bank value date and booking date as different, and compare against the D365 transaction date using the date tolerance
Detect a returned or reversed donation and pair it with the original credit rather than reporting two unmatched lines
